# SOP-MSG-02 Mailbox full or over quota

Applies to: Microsoft Outlook / Exchange Online
Symptoms: mailbox full, quota exceeded, cannot send because mailbox is full

Steps for the user:
1. Empty the Deleted Items and Junk Email folders.
2. Sort the mailbox by size and delete or save large attachments to OneDrive.
3. Turn on the Online Archive: File > Tools > Mailbox Cleanup > Archive older items.
4. Restart Outlook and check the mailbox size in File > Info.

Escalation: Escalate to Messaging & Collaboration Support if a mailbox quota increase is needed.
response:
To resolve the mailbox full error in Outlook, please follow these steps:
1. Empty the Deleted Items and Junk Email folders to free up space.
2. Sort your mailbox by size and delete or save large attachments to OneDrive.
3. Turn on the Online Archive by going to File > Tools > Mailbox Cleanup > Archive older items.
4. Restart Outlook and check your mailbox size in File > Info.
If you still need more space after these steps, please contact Messaging & Collaboration Support to request a mailbox quota increase.

# SOP-TMS-01 Teams audio or video problems in meetings

Applies to: Microsoft Teams
Symptoms: no sound, microphone not working, camera not detected, echo, others cannot hear me

Steps for the user:
1. In Teams, open Settings > Devices and select the correct speaker, microphone and camera.
2. Make a test call from Settings > Devices > Make a test call.
3. Close other applications that may use the camera or microphone.
4. Unplug and reconnect the headset or docking station, then restart Teams.
5. Check the Windows privacy settings: Settings > Privacy > Microphone and Camera must allow Teams.

Escalation: Escalate to Messaging & Collaboration Support if the problem continues after a restart of the laptop.
response: Hi! Sorry to hear your mic isn't working in Teams. Please try the following steps quickly: 1) Check that your microphone is properly connected and not muted. 2) In Teams, click on your profile picture > Settings > Devices, and ensure the correct microphone is selected. 3) Test your mic in the device settings or in Teams by making a test call. 4) If using an external mic, try unplugging and plugging it back in. 5) Restart Teams if needed. This should resolve the issue so you can be heard in your meeting. Let us know if you need further help!

# SOP-TMS-02 Teams sign-in loop or Teams will not start

Applies to: Microsoft Teams
Symptoms: teams keeps asking to sign in, blank white screen, teams crashes on start

Steps for the user:
1. Quit Teams completely from the system tray.
2. Clear the Teams cache: delete the contents of %appdata%\Microsoft\Teams (classic) or reset the new Teams app in Settings > Apps.
3. Start Teams and sign in with your work account.
4. If the problem continues, use Teams on the web (teams.microsoft.com) while the desktop app is checked.

Escalation: Escalate to Messaging & Collaboration Support if Teams on the web also fails.
response: Hi! Sorry to hear you're stuck in a sign-in loop on the Teams desktop app. Since the web version works, let's try clearing the Teams cache and signing in again. Please close Teams completely, then navigate to %appdata%\Microsoft\Teams on your computer and delete the contents of the Cache folder. After that, restart Teams and try signing in again. This usually resolves sign-in loop issues. Let me know if you need further help!

Symptoms: laptop slow, computer freezing, disk full, low storage

Steps for the user:
1. Restart the laptop; do not only close the lid.
2. Install pending updates from Settings > Windows Update and restart again.
3. Run Disk Cleanup and delete temporary files; move large personal files to OneDrive.
4. Close applications that start automatically and are not needed (Task Manager > Startup).

Escalation: Escalate to End-User Computing if the laptop is still slow after updates or the disk fails.
response: Hello! The low disk space warning is likely causing your laptop to slow down. To resolve this, please try deleting unnecessary files or uninstalling unused programs to free up space. You can also empty the Recycle Bin and clear temporary files. If you need guidance on how to do this, let me know!

# SOP-EUC-02 External monitor or docking station not working

Applies to: Windows laptop / endpoint
Symptoms: second screen not detected, docking station not working, monitor black

Steps for the user:
1. Disconnect and reconnect the docking station cable to the laptop.
2. Check that the monitor is switched on and set to the correct input.
3. Press Windows + P and select Extend.
4. Restart the laptop while it is connected to the docking station.

Escalation: Escalate to End-User Computing if the monitor or docking station appears faulty.
response:
Hi, to resolve the issue with your second screen not being detected through the docking station, please try the following steps:
1. Disconnect and reconnect the docking station cable to your laptop.
2. Ensure that the external monitor is switched on and set to the correct input source.
3. Press Windows + P on your keyboard and select Extend to enable the second screen.
4. If the issue persists, restart your laptop while it is connected to the docking station.
If after these steps the monitor or docking station still does not work, please let us know so we can escalate the issue to End-User Computing support for further assistance.

# SOP-ERP-01 SAP: invoice posting fails

Applies to: SAP S/4HANA Finance
Symptoms: cannot post invoice, posting period closed, posting error, document not posted

Steps for the user:
1. Read the full error message and note the message number (for example F5 201 'posting period not open').
2. Check that the posting date is in an open period; if the period is closed, change the posting date to the current period if this is allowed by the finance policy.
3. Check that the vendor and cost centre are not blocked.
4. Retry the posting once. Do not retry repeatedly, as this can create duplicate documents.

Escalation: Escalate to ERP Finance Support with the message number if the posting still fails, or immediately if month-end closing is affected.
response: The error 'posting period not open' means the posting date is in a closed period. Please check that the posting date of your invoice is in an open period. If the period is closed, change the posting date to the current open period if this is allowed by your finance policy. Also, ensure that the vendor and cost centre are not blocked. After making these checks and adjustments, please retry posting the invoice once. Avoid retrying repeatedly to prevent duplicate documents. If the posting still fails, please escalate to ERP Finance Support with the error message number for further assistance.

# SOP-EUC-03 Printer problems

Applies to: Windows laptop / endpoint
Symptoms: cannot print, printer offline, print job stuck

Steps for the user:
1. Check that the printer is switched on and has paper and toner.
2. Remove stuck jobs from the print queue and print again.
3. Remove the printer in Settings > Printers and add it again from the Company Portal.
4. Try printing to another printer to see whether the problem is the laptop or the printer.

Escalation: Escalate to End-User Computing if the printer itself shows an error.
response:
Hi,

Please check that the printer on the second floor is switched on and has paper and toner. If it is, try removing any stuck jobs from the print queue and then print again. If the problem persists, remove the printer in Settings > Printers and add it again from the Company Portal. You can also try printing to another printer to determine if the issue is with the laptop or the printer itself.

If the printer shows an error, please let us know so we can escalate to End-User Computing.

Best regards,
IT Service Desk

# SOP-TMS-02 Teams sign-in loop or Teams will not start

Applies to: Microsoft Teams
Symptoms: teams keeps asking to sign in, blank white screen, teams crashes on start

Steps for the user:
1. Quit Teams completely from the system tray.
2. Clear the Teams cache: delete the contents of %appdata%\Microsoft\Teams (classic) or reset the new Teams app in Settings > Apps.
3. Start Teams and sign in with your work account.
4. If the problem continues, use Teams on the web (teams.microsoft.com) while the desktop app is checked.

Escalation: Escalate to Messaging & Collaboration Support if Teams on the web also fails.
response: Hi! It sounds like Teams is stuck in a sign-in loop on your laptop. Let's try a few quick steps to fix this: 1) Completely sign out of Teams and close the app. 2) Clear the Teams cache by navigating to %appdata%\Microsoft\Teams on your laptop and deleting the contents of the Cache folder. 3) Restart your laptop. 4) Open Teams and sign in again. This usually resolves the issue. If the problem persists, please let us know and we can explore further options. Thanks!

# SOP-IAM-02 Account locked or new phone for MFA

Applies to: Microsoft Entra ID / single sign-on
Symptoms: account locked, too many attempts, new phone authenticator, mfa not working

Steps for the user:
1. Wait 15 minutes; accounts unlock automatically after repeated failed attempts.
2. Make sure that no old device is trying to sign in with an old password (for example a phone email app).
3. For a new phone, sign in at mysignins.example with your old phone or a temporary access pass and add the new device.
4. If you have no access to any registered method, contact the service desk to verify your identity.

Escalation: Escalate to Identity & Access Management for a temporary access pass or if the account stays locked.
response: Your account may be locked due to too many failed sign-in attempts. Please wait 15 minutes as accounts typically unlock automatically after this period. Also, ensure that no old device is trying to sign in with an old password, such as a phone email app. If you have a new phone, you can sign in at mysignins.example using your old phone or a temporary access pass to add the new device. If you do not have access to any registered method, please contact the service desk to verify your identity so we can assist you further.

# SOP-MSG-03 Add a shared mailbox or shared calendar

Applies to: Microsoft Outlook / Exchange Online
Symptoms: how to open shared mailbox, add shared calendar, access team mailbox

Steps for the user:
1. Confirm that the owner of the shared mailbox has granted you access.
2. In Outlook, select File > Account Settings > Account Settings > Change > More Settings > Advanced > Add, and enter the mailbox name.
3. To add a shared calendar, open Calendar > Add calendar > From address book and select the calendar.
4. Restart Outlook if the mailbox does not appear within 30 minutes.

Escalation: Escalate to Messaging & Collaboration Support if access has been granted but the mailbox still does not open after one hour.
response:
To add a shared mailbox in Outlook, please follow these steps:
1. Confirm that the owner of the shared mailbox has granted you access.
2. In Outlook, select File > Account Settings > Account Settings > Change > More Settings > Advanced > Add, and enter the mailbox name.
3. If the mailbox does not appear within 30 minutes, restart Outlook.

If you have access but still cannot open the mailbox after one hour, please contact Messaging & Collaboration Support for further assistance.

# SOP-MSG-02 Mailbox full or over quota

Applies to: Microsoft Outlook / Exchange Online
Symptoms: mailbox full, quota exceeded, cannot send because mailbox is full

Steps for the user:
1. Empty the Deleted Items and Junk Email folders.
2. Sort the mailbox by size and delete or save large attachments to OneDrive.
3. Turn on the Online Archive: File > Tools > Mailbox Cleanup > Archive older items.
4. Restart Outlook and check the mailbox size in File > Info.

Escalation: Escalate to Messaging & Collaboration Support if a mailbox quota increase is needed.
response: Hello! It looks like your mailbox has exceeded its storage quota, which is why you're unable to send emails. To resolve this quickly, please try deleting or archiving some old emails, especially those with large attachments, to free up space. You can also empty your Deleted Items and Junk Email folders. Once you've freed up enough space, you should be able to send emails again. If you need assistance with this or if the issue persists, please let us know, and we'll help you promptly. Good luck with your tender deadline!
